command: pwd && ls -la && find . -maxdepth 3 -type f | sort | sed -n '1,200p'

nl -ba src/inventory/pricing.py && printf '
--- tests/test_pricing.py ---
' && nl -ba tests/test_pricing.py && printf '
--- pyproject.toml ---
' && cat pyproject.toml && printf '
--- tests/conftest.py ---
' && cat tests/conftest.py

pytest -q && PYTHONPATH=src python - <<'EOF'
from inventory.pricing import apply_coupon

assert apply_coupon(100.00, "SAVE10") == 90.00
assert apply_coupon(19.99, "SAVE10") == 17.99
assert apply_coupon(20.00, "FLAT5") == 15.00
assert apply_coupon(5.00, "FLAT5") == 0.00
assert apply_coupon(2.00, "FLAT5") == 0.00
try:
    apply_coupon(10.00, "NOPE")
except ValueError as exc:
    assert "NOPE" in str(exc)
else:
    raise AssertionError("unknown coupon code did not raise ValueError")
print("coupon edge cases passed")
EOF

PYTHONPATH=src python3 - <<'EOF'

assert apply_coupon(100.00, "SAVE10") == 90.00
assert apply_coupon(19.99, "SAVE10") == 17.99

assert apply_coupon(5.00, "FLAT5") == 0.00
assert apply_coupon(2.00, "FLAT5") == 0.00
try:
    apply_coupon(10.00, "NOPE")
except ValueError as exc:
    assert "NOPE" in str(exc)
else:
    raise AssertionError("unknown coupon code did not raise ValueError")
print("coupon edge cases passed")
EOF
git diff -- src/inventory/pricing.py tests/test_smoke.py
